# Household upkeep. One entry scaling on how many offices are filled, rather
# than a cost line inside each office, because an office block is multiplied by
# its holder's level and the overhead should not be.
cc_office_household_upkeep = {
	requires_real = yes

	potential_trigger = {
		cc_office_filled_count > 0
	}

	scales_with = { value = cc_office_filled_count }

	court_spending_efficiency = -0.02
}
